version.changelog:
Initial release of Privacy Policy Generator.

- Generate privacy policies for apps and websites with support for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
- Includes commands for generating, auditing, and customizing privacy policies.
- Offers a quick reference table and helpful tips for getting started.

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions are consistent with a privacy-policy generator: no unexpected network calls, no secret access, and no install steps.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included files: SKILL.md documents policy-generation commands and privacy.sh emits prompt templates for those commands. No extraneous capabilities (cloud, git, or other services) are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is limited to command documentation and usage. The runtime script composes prompt text and echoes user input; it does not instruct the agent to read files, environment variables, or transmit data to external endpoints beyond normal model invocation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification is provided and the skill is instruction-only with a small local shell helper; nothing is downloaded or written to disk during installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths; the code does not access secrets or external credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated or persistent platform-wide privileges. disable-model-invocation is false (normal behavior) but there are no other concerning privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to simply generate prompt templates for producing privacy policies and does not exfiltrate data or request secrets. Before use: (1) verify the BytesAgain contact/branding if that matters to you; (2) avoid pasting real personal data or Secrets into prompts (the skill will echo whatever you send); (3) treat generated legal text as a draft — have a qualified lawyer review final policies for compliance with GDPR/CCPA and local law; (4) test outputs for completeness and localization (Chinese/English) before publishing.
